column3: Add a lightweight Python FastAPI proxy (port 8020) that the dashboard calls every 30s via fetch(). It queries yfinance for real quotes and returns JSON. Replaces all static data.
Wire the search bar to call /api/search?q=AAPL on the backend — which queries yfinance's ticker lookup. Returns live price + fundamentals for any valid symbol.
Every Friday at 4:05pm the cron fires — but the dashboard doesn't pick up the new signal. A setInterval polling /api/signal/latest would show the new scale + holdings immediately.
Type SPY or QQQ in search → show near-term expiry chains (calls + puts) with IV, delta, OI. Critical for your SPY positions.
